story: After numerous attacks in the opening kilometres, a two-rider breakaway formed after half an hour. Johansen later dropped back to the peloton, allowing Narváez to collect bonus seconds at the intermediate sprint. Bayer and Wang subsequently joined Sütterlin at the front. Soudal Quick-Step, Decathlon and XDS Astana led the chase, catching the breakaway with 20 kilometres remaining. The sprint preparation was disorganised, with no team taking full control. Frétin ultimately won the bunch sprint after Magnier unclipped from his pedal.
